title: Quiet passive roster freshness alerts
summary: Night Roster keeps sync age visible without treating a few quiet minutes as an incident, while push notifications stay focused on roster issues that genuinely need a nurse to act.
changes: Removes the three-minute age-only stale warning so an otherwise healthy online roster no longer raises a prominent Roster may be stale card simply because no full refresh happened for a few minutes.
Keeps freshness visible in the compact Night status strip while reserving in-app sync warnings for real stale or error states reported by the shared-data runtime.
Stops technical refresh and sync-health items from generating Night Intelligence push notifications or app-badge attention, while preserving meaningful staffing, allocation and conflict alerts.
Adds regression coverage so passive refresh age cannot silently become an attention warning or noisy push path again.
